explanation: Only nonzero at D1, and there it depends only on the state reached on the previous trial: about 0 if that was S1, high if it was S2 (about 10 when the agent had chosen a1 and got to S2 by a rare transition; about 6-7 when it chose a2 and got to S2 normally, early in the episode, rising to 8-9 after trial 85). GO and D2 are always 0, apart from an occasional 1-2.
